name: Vice Got a Price!
guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work through the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then the Strangers strands and whatever is left. Expect roughly 200 hours in a single playthrough, all of it offline.

name: A Long Road
guide: The 100% checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, once the credits roll, and it is the longest grind in the game. You need every robbery, every underwater discovery, every shooting range and every drone race, plus the Bret questline, but only 70 of the 80 Challenges. Track it in the checklist itself and mop up the rest with this guide's filters; most of what it asks for also pops its own trophy on the way.

name: Cunning Stunts
guide: Leonida holds 397 stunts: jumps, flights under bridges, Knife Flights and base jumps. You only need 250, so skip the ones that look miserable and take the easy jumps and bridge flights you pass anyway. Stunt jumps show up on the map once you find them, so sweep a district at a time rather than criss-crossing the state.

name: You WAiNKer!
guide: Open the WAiNK app on your phone and scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures as you travel; the counter climbs with each new spot. Make it a habit at every new town or viewpoint and the hundred comes naturally before the story ends. Scanning vehicles with the same app also counts toward Whip It Good.

name: Don't Touch My Deck
guide: There are 18 card sets scattered across Leonida, and you only need to finish three of them. Cards turn up in shops, in the world and as mission rewards, so grab every pack you see and check your collection often. Finish the three shortest sets first instead of chasing a rare card in a long one.

name: One Last Thing
guide: The game tracks 80 Challenges across combat, driving, exploration and more, and fifty is enough. Pick the ones that match how you already play - races, stunts and scans - and let the counter fill up in the background. The 100% checklist wants 70, so anything you do here counts twice.

name: Whip It Good
guide: Every new vehicle you spot counts once it is discovered, and a quick WAiNK scan is enough - you never have to steal or drive it. Scan traffic at busy intersections and car parks, and the hundred arrives fast. The checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning after this pops.

name: The Goodtime State
guide: Drive, fly or sail until the fog lifts from every corner of the map. The easiest way is to take a plane or helicopter along the coastline and over the countryside in long sweeps, dipping into each grey patch. Fast travel does not reveal fog, so the miles have to be travelled.

name: Positive Mental Attitude
description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida
guide: There are 18 Meditation Spots across Leonida, and this is the one trophy you can miss. Early in Chapter 1, Lucia mentions meditation in the kitchen at Jason's house one morning and walks out to the balcony - follow her, take the prompt and let her show you how it works. That balcony meditation raises your counter but is not marked as a spot, and it cannot be done again after Chapter 1, so do it the first time you see it, then visit the other 17 marked spots.

name: Actions Speak Louder
guide: Five hundred actions that move your Criminal Profile: robberies, getaways, stunts, heists and the rest of the outlaw life. There is no menu to grind - just play the game the way it wants to be played and the counter climbs. It pops long before the platinum if you are doing the robbery and stunt trophies anyway.

name: Master of None
description: Try each type of activity once
guide: Nine activity types, one try each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. None of them has to be won or finished well - starting is enough. Knock them out early, since most of them have their own trophies waiting behind them.

name: The Shootist
description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges
guide: Twelve shooting ranges hold 42 challenges between them, and every one needs a gold medal. Learn each range's weapon and target pattern, take your time on the first run to learn the layout, then go for speed and accuracy. This is one of the two hardest trophies in the set, so leave it until your aim is warm from the story.

name: Top Fun
description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location
guide: Fourteen drone race locations, one win at each. The drones handle like aircraft, so brake early for gates and cut corners where the course allows. The 100% checklist wants every drone race, so a win here is progress twice over.

name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
guide: Forty races are spread across Leonida and you need a win in twenty different ones. Enter whatever race is nearby as you travel and the wins pile up; there is no need to chase a specific series. A fast car and clean corners matter more than the race type.

name: Baited My Tackle
description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
guide: Cal's questline starts in Chapter 1 and ends in a fishing contest against him. Fish the spots he marks, watch the tension meter, and reel in steady bursts instead of holding the line. The contest is the last step of his strand, so finish his earlier quests first.

name: Stick Fiddler
guide: Four video games are playable and any one of them counts; three sit on the TV at home, so you never have to leave the house. Pick the shortest one, learn its controls in a practice round, then play it through. Beating it is enough - no high score needed.

name: Personal Best
guide: Both Jason and Lucia need maxed Strength at the same time. Go to the gym together: while one of them works out, the other trains on their own, so progress effectively doubles. Keep at it between missions and the trophy pops once the second bar fills.

name: Road to Rehabilitation
description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
guide: Andy's strand is five quests, open to Lucia only, from Chapter 3. Follow the purple stranger icons and finish each job he gives you; the last one closes the strand and pops the trophy. Nothing in it is missable - he stays available in free roam after the story.

name: This Was No Boat Accident
description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
guide: Kenton wants seven shipwrecks cleared, starting in Chapter 1. Dive each wreck, clear what is inside and move on to the next marker. He goes quiet for a stretch mid-story, so do not worry if his icon vanishes - he comes back.

name: The Lone Rider
description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
guide: Billy's five quests run out of the Thrillbilly Mudclub from Chapter 2. Mud, bikes and bad decisions - finish all five and the strand closes. His missions are loud and easy to spot on the map.

name: Strangers & Freaks
description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
guide: Eight full Strangers & Freaks questlines, and the checklist does not ask for them, so they are usually the last thing standing. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret cover six of the eight; finish any two more strands and the silver is yours. Do them after the story when the map is fully open.

name: Supply & Demand
description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
guide: Randy hands you a wish list of sixteen cars to deliver, from Chapter 3. Steal or buy each model, drive it to his drop-off and tick it off; the list shows what is still missing. The last delivery closes the strand.

name: Spin On This!
description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
guide: Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, from Chapter 3, and it ends with destroying the labs and finishing his last quest. Follow his markers, clear the labs, and the final mission wraps it up. His jobs are combat-heavy, so bring armour and ammo.

name: Fair Game
description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
guide: Bret's hunt is Jason-only, and the exact animal is still being confirmed by players. Study animals through your binoculars as you roam - the checklist wants 100 of the 255 studied anyway - and take Bret's quest when his icon appears. The 100% checklist needs his questline, so do not skip it.

name: Hot Together
description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
guide: Build a four-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then break away until the heat dies. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the easy escape: police struggle to follow along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you. It pops once you leave the red heat zone, and it often unlocks by itself during a bank vault robbery.

name: Retail Therapy
description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while staying wanted the whole time. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well - hit them in sequence and do not let the heat drop between stops. The trophy is delayed and pops about half a minute after you leave the third store.

name: Sneakthief
description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
guide: You need the Snap Gun, which arrives in Chapter 3, and a jewelry store with no eyes on you. Case the store first, wait for the staff to turn away, and take the goods without tripping the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try another store - detection fails the attempt, not the trophy.

name: Maximum Withdrawal
guide: Eight bank vaults exist and five successful robberies with a clean getaway are enough. Plan the escape before the alarm: a fast car parked nearby, or the Ambrosia train tunnel trick from Hot Together. The checklist wants every robbery, so the last three vaults still count after this pops.

name: A Classic Blitz Play
description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
guide: Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, crack it open and get away before the police close in. A sticky bomb or a hard ram does the stopping; the getaway is the hard part, so have your exit route picked before you strike.

name: Pest Control
description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
guide: Nine gangs run 39 illegal operations between them, and you need one hit on each gang. Mark the operations on the map, work through the gangs one by one, and keep your weapons stocked. The checklist asks for more than this trophy does, so the extra hits still count.

name: Let's Go Bowling
description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, take all three key valuables and then lose the police. Move fast inside, grab each valuable in turn, and have a car waiting outside for the getaway. The name is a joke - the bowling is optional.

name: Dime on the Dollar
description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
guide: Marked Bills pile up from robberies and heists, and fences turn them into clean cash. Keep feeding bills through your contacts until a quarter of a million is laundered; the counter is cumulative, so small batches add up. Robberies pay for this one on their own if you keep laundering instead of hoarding.

name: Treat Yo Self
guide: A hundred thousand dollars across any shops - clothes, weapons, food, car mods, all of it counts. Spend as you play and it pops on its own; if it is the last one standing, buy a round of expensive clothes or weapon attachments to close the gap.

name: Little Boxes
guide: Eight garages are for sale across Leonida for $160,000 in total. Buy them as you can afford them - each one also gives you somewhere to store the cars Randy wants. The last purchase pops the trophy.

name: On the Spot
description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
guide: Open the Scooter Bros app, pick a vehicle you own and register it; ten registrations is all it takes. Use cheap cars you already own rather than buying new ones, and the trophy pops at the tenth.

name: Gunslinger
description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
guide: Buff your focus first - food, drinks or a shower at home - and bring Adrenaline and an assault rifle. The five takedowns must land inside one Combat Focus use, and gang members at their illegal operations are the reliable targets: it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Pick a busy gang spot and let focus do the work.

name: Catch Me If You Can
description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
guide: Steal an airliner docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA - the ones at terminals E3 and E4 are the easy grabs - and fly it a kilometre away from the airport. It pops once you are clear; expect the full wanted response on the runway, so go at full throttle and do not stop for anything.

name: Challenging Tank
guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station. The base is guarded and the response is immediate, so go in fast, grab the Rhino and drive out before the gates close. Once you are rolling, nothing much can stop you.

name: In The Beginning…
description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
guide: The exact trigger is still unconfirmed, but the description points at a cocktail with an Ocean Beach view. Order a drink at a beachfront bar and watch the water; players are still pinning down which spot counts. This guide will be updated as the method is confirmed.

name: Capital Offense
description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
guide: The trigger is still unconfirmed, but the description is a straight hint: take a car and smash out of a vehicle showroom. Try the showrooms around Vice City in a fast car and drive straight through the glass. This guide will be updated once players confirm the exact spot.

name: Bad Luck, I Guess
guide: The description hints at a second attempt at something, but no one has confirmed the trigger yet. Keep playing and it may pop on its own; this guide will be updated as soon as the method is pinned down.

name: The Truth Is Out There
guide: The description hints at something strange, and the trigger is still unknown. It is one of five hidden trophies players have not solved yet - likely tied to an odd event or location somewhere in Leonida. This guide will be updated when the method is confirmed.

name: Ten Pin
description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by - a swing from a moving vehicle. The exact trigger is still being confirmed, so try it on a pedestrian from a slow-moving car in a quiet street. This guide will be updated once players confirm the method.

name: Just Like Paradise
guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, is Jason's first job, and the trophy pops when it ends. It unlocks automatically and cannot be missed - just play the story.

name: Paradise Lost
guide: Finish Chapter 1 and the trophy pops as Chapter 2 begins, after the first mission of the new chapter. Automatic and unmissable.

name: Tits Ass Drug Money
guide: Finish Chapter 2 and the trophy pops as Chapter 3 opens, after the first mission there. Automatic and unmissable. The name shows censored as T**s Ass Drug Money on some trackers.

name: Vice City, Baby!
guide: Finish Chapter 3 and the trophy pops. Automatic and unmissable - just keep playing the story.

name: Top Of The World, Ma
guide: Finish Chapter 4 and the trophy pops. Automatic and unmissable.

name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
guide: Finish the final story mission and the gold is yours. Automatic and unmissable - and once the credits roll, the 100% checklist opens and free roam begins.

name: Trust
guide: Complete the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run. Automatic and unmissable.

name: Break the Bank
guide: Complete the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist. Automatic and unmissable.

name: Family Matters
guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play. Automatic and unmissable.

name: DWNFALL
guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners. Automatic and unmissable.

name: Hi-Jacked
guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown. Automatic and unmissable.

name: Snow Storm
guide: Complete the Chapter 5 story mission Operation Savage Glory. Automatic and unmissable.
